fnol_text: My name is Amara Khan and I live at 596 Briar Court, Greenville, SC 29612. You can reach me on (555) 566-6887 or amara.khan@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 7 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00138. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Khan on (555) 566-6887 to acknowledge the claim. Amara confirmed the loss date as 7 August 2024.
Site visit to 596 Briar Court. Neighbour Gabriel Zielinski was present and confirmed the timeline.
Amara sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
